evaluation.label: Generally yes

issues.description: Sentence S14 states that the Group reorganised its operations into two segments during the year, but does not explain how this reorganization impacts the comparability of the segment figures presented in S11 and S13. Without clarification on whether the prior-year figures have been restated to reflect the new structure, the reader cannot fully assess the significance of the reported changes.

evaluation.justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative linking programme delays to financial performance impacts. The structure logically progresses from overall performance to segment details and then to cash position and strategy. The only notable gap is in S14 where the reorganization of segments is mentioned without explaining its effect on prior period comparability. This creates a small logical gap because the reader cannot determine whether the segment performance changes are due to operational improvements or merely a new reporting structure. All other elements (cause-effect relationships, comparisons, and overall organization) are internally consistent and well-structured. There are no self-contradictions, unnecessary repetitions, or severe organizational problems.
